description: The Bhagavad Gītā — 700 verses in 18 chapters, the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukṣetra, forming chapters 23–40 of Book 6 (Bhīṣma-parvan) of the Mahābhārata (BORI critical edition). Sanskrit text collated from the GRETIL e-text (BORI/Tokunaga/Smith) against the vulgate numbering; English translation is the public-domain 1909 rendering by Swami Swarupananda (Advaita Ashrama).

sources.title: Bhagavadgītā — GRETIL e-text (Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages)
sources.notes: Machine-readable Sanskrit text of the vulgate Bhagavad Gītā based on the BORI critical edition (MBh 6.23–40). Input by Muneo Tokunaga et al., revised by John Smith (Cambridge), GRETIL UTF-8 IAST. Used as the primary witness for the base Sanskrit text. Text is public domain (ancient work); digital file is provided for scholarly reference. Attribution required per GRETIL terms.

sources.title: Srimad-Bhagavad-Gita, English translation and commentary by Swami Swarupananda, [1909]
sources.edition_note: First published 1909 (manuscripts begun 1901, ready 1903, delayed; published posthumously in Prabuddha Bharata monthly instalments after author's death 27 June 1906, then in book form 18 Oct 1909). Sacred-texts.com e-text scanned, proofed and formatted by John Bruno Hare, March 2008.
sources.notes: Author died 27 June 1906 (Nainital), first president of Advaita Ashrama (disciple of Vivekananda). Published 1909, therefore public domain in US (pre-1923), India (life+60 expired 31 Dec 1966) and EU/US life+70 (expired 31 Dec 1976). Sacred-texts page explicitly: 'This text is in the public domain in the US because it was published prior to 1923.' Archive.org copy marked 'Out_of_copyright'.
